purpose: Fixed question set for measuring the conversation LAYOUT of the web chat (cards, pictures, quote line, tables). Run each question in a NEW chat on the UAT server (localhost:3000, logged in), in this order, then read the tappyai_one_brain_media / tappyai_image_sense lines of the log (see scripts/uat/layout-metrics.mjs). 16/11/2026.

thresholds.compare: cards declared (declared includes 'profiles') in at least 9 of 10; at most one table per answer (md_tables + compare block)
thresholds.look: gallery declared in at least 8 of 10 and drawn (gallery_images >= 1); no picture the owner marks wrong
thresholds.abstract: no gallery, no cards in 10 of 10
thresholds.howto: no gallery, no cards in 10 of 10
thresholds.short: no gallery, no cards, no quote line in 10 of 10
